**Executive Overview:**
A Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Trans-Transformers (BERT) - Based Approach for Real-Time News Summarization and SentimentDetection. The system integrates the following components: real-time web scraping using Selenium for dynamiccontent retrieval and sentiment analysis. The platform is implemented using Python and the Flask webframework, and supports concurrent execution.

**Detailed Section Synthesis:**
A Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Trans-Transformers (BERT) - Based Approach for Real-Time News Summarization and SentimentDetection. Gunjan Patil, Ashwini Raorane, Sahil Jain, Varad Kotalwar. The paper was published by the Adik Institute of Technology in Mumbai, India. It is based on a BERT-based transformer model for abstractive summarization.

The system integrates the following components: real-time web scraping using Selenium for dynamiccontent retrieval and sentiment analysis. The platform is implemented using Python and the Flask webframework, and supports concurrent execution. Users can submit topical queries, upon which the system performs summarization, clas- siﬁes sentiment, and returns structured summaries linked to live news sources. The paper was presented at the 4th International Conference for Advancement in Technology (ICONAT) in Goa, India.

The advent of deep learning began a shift toward abstractive techniques capable of generating moresophisticated and human-like text. The introduction of the Transformer architecture, and pre-trained models like BERT, marked a signiﬁcant turning point for ATS, enabling unprecedented performance. Many studies now focus on creating hybrid architecturesto further enhance performance. The powerof these large language models was further demonstrated by a team who created a benchmark corpus of Urdu news articles.

abstractive summarization with real-time data ingestion androbust sentiment analysis. The proposed system is an advanced artiﬁcial intelligencedriven news summarization platform. It is built as a robust, full-stack web application. The system allows users to input custom queries or select prede ﬁned topics of interest. It fetches relevant articles from the web using automated scraping and RSS feed integration. The platform generates concise, abstractive.summaries enriched with sentiment analysis that reﬂects the emotional tone of the news.

The proposed AI-powered news summarization system was evaluated across multiple dimensions including summary qual-ity, semantic similarity, sentiment classiﬁcation accuracy, and real-time responsiveness. The system was built on Flask, the backend supports Docker and is deployable to cloud platforms such as Heroku or Railway. A set of 9 diverse news articles covering topics such as AI, technology, and geopolitical events were selected and the system performed live scraping.

The suggested method does well in sentiment analysis and summaries. The system can analyze articles in almost real-time because it typically takes 5.4 seconds per article. Although sentiment analysis has a 92% accuracy. rate, it may overlook some sentiment cases, as indicated by its recall of 0.40. Authorized licensed use limited to: GITAM University. The Proposed System is based on an abstractive model based on BERT. It is able to dynamicallyretrieve and process real-time news articles. TextRank and T5 Abstractive are unable to do this and work with pre-existing content. The suggested method is faster than the more computationally demanding T5 but slower than TextRank. The proposed system offers a superior balance between performance and utility. It combines web scraping, abstractive sum-marization using transformer models, and sentiment analysis.

The system demon-strated high accuracy in sentiment classiﬁcation and ﬂuency in summaries. The integration of parallel processing and dy-namic content extraction ensures responsiveness. The use of BERT-based models enables semantic understanding. Compared to traditional extractive methods, the proposed solution offers a more intelligent and personalized approach to news consumption. In conclusion, the system sets a foundation for intelligent, real-time news aggregation and summarization.
